messages: #p602#, who I met at #m10005000#, seems to be hiding something.

#p602#, who I met at #m10005000#, wouldn't say a word, insisting that person wouldn't want to be known — but worn down by my persistent pleading, he reluctantly set one condition. That condition was for me to bring him #t4000036# for his research. It seems I should be able to get #b#t4000036#s#k by defeating #b#o40#s#k, found far off from #m10004000#, or #b#o45#s#k deep within the Ant Tunnel.  \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.#k
I handed over the #t4000036#s to #p602#, who I met at #m10005000#. Now it's time to hear his story about the warrior who saved #p207#.
name: A Price to Pay
